The playground "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"even drives the demo page's own tab favicon, exactly like the plugin does on a DSH page."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## ✨ What it does"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Live session state on the tab favicon** — the browser-tab icon mirrors `idle` / `running` / `ask"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ing` / `done` (aggregate priority: `asking` > `running` > `done` > `idle`), so background tabs tell "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"you at a glance what your agents are doing — including `ask_user_question` prompts and approval / sa"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ndbox-escalation waits, which pin the icon to `asking`.
- **One SVG, recolored & animated in the bro"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"wser** — ships a single whale template (`icons/base.svg`); every state, color and frame is rendered "},{"id":"p8s6","text":"client-side as a `data:image/svg+xml` URI. No per-color icon files.
- **Six built-in effects** — `st"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"atic`, `blink`, `breath`, `rainbow`, `heartbeat`, `bounce` — all driven by JavaScript, since favicon"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"s don't play SVG CSS animations.
- **Fully configurable, applied live** — every state's color, effec"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"t and cycle speed, plus the asking/done hold timings, apply to the running tab within ~1 s — no relo"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"ad, no restart.
- **Built-in settings UI, zero YAML** — the *Favicon indicator* page edits the whole"},{"id":"p8s11","text":" config with live color-swatch previews and persists it for you (modern hosts: the profile patch; le"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"gacy hosts: the profile `settings.yaml` — paths below).
- **Background-tab & restart-proof** — anima"},{"id":"p8s13","text":"ted states keep a wall-clock fallback while `requestAnimationFrame` is paused in hidden tabs, and th"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"e status poll self-heals across host restarts. Returning to a tab repaints immediately: a `visibilit"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"ychange` listener fires an instant status fetch, so a state that flipped while the tab was hidden (e"},{"id":"p8s16","text":".g. the `done` hold expiring) shows at once instead of waiting for the next — possibly throttled — p"},{"id":"p8s17","text":"oll tick. When the backend is stopped, the tab never loses its icon: the outage restores the shell's"},{"id":"p8s18","text":" own favicon from an offline-safe `data:`-URI copy (or keeps the last painted frame), and the live i"},{"id":"p8s19","text":"con returns on the first successful poll.

| Safari (iOS) | ✅ rendered static | ⚠️ rarely | Unlikely to refresh without revisiting the tab. |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Known limitations (current as of Safari 26.3):"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **Favicons have their own cache.** Chrome keeps a favicon database, Firefox a `favicons.sqlite`, a"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"nd **Safari a system-level icon cache** — none of which a normal *clear cache* touches, and WebKit e"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ven caches the "no icon" case. That is why a changed icon can linger for an existing tab. The plugin"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" already mitigates this: it serves `base.svg` and the status endpoint with `Cache-Control: no-store`"},{"id":"p19s5","text":", bundles a freshness query (`?t=Date.now()`) on its fetches, and replaces the `<link rel=icon>` nod"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"e on each state change.
- **A theme-scoped favicon pair must be collapsed first (DSH ≥ 0.1.7).** The"},{"id":"p19s7","text":" shell's `index.html` ships *two* `rel=icon` links — `favicon-dark.svg` for `prefers-color-scheme: d"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"ark` and `favicon.svg` for light — because up to `0.1.6-alpha.2` there was exactly one. A browser re"},{"id":"p19s9","text":"solves the favicon to the **last connected link whose `media` matches**, so repainting only the firs"},{"id":"p19s10","text":"t one left the tab showing the shell's icon no matter what the session did. The plugin now normalize"},{"id":"p19s11","text":"s the set to a single always-matching link at startup (keeping the variant your scheme selects) befo"},{"id":"p19s12","text":"re painting. If you are on a version before 0.5.2 and the tab icon simply never changes, this is why"},{"id":"p19s13","text":"g. [该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Caveats"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- Favicon SVG CSS animations do not run inside the browser's tab UI — all effects are produced in Ja"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"vaScript by rebuilding the data-URI each frame. This is a deliberate, zero-dependency design. (The a"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"nimated previews in this README are demo assets for illustration only — the favicon itself is JS-ani"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"mated.)
- Favicon behavior differs by browser, and Safari is the most limited — see Browser support "},{"id":"p21s5","text":"& known limitations.
- The base template must keep its `__COLOR__` placeholder in the `#p { fill: … "},{"id":"p21s6","text":"}` rule; the browser replaces that token to color each frame.
- The plugin runs in the **host** plan"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"e; it must be mounted into a profile's composition, not a session-scoped agent preset.
- File reads "},{"id":"p21s8","text":"go through the `fs` service with the configured `iconsDir` as `cwd`. Make sure that path is readable"},{"id":"p21s9","text":" under your deployment's sandbox policy."}],"truncated":true}
